crossrefs.text: Hide not Your face from Your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me quickly!
In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried to my God for help. From His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for His help reached His ears.
Out of the depths I cry to You, O LORD!
O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.
You do not even know what will happen tomorrow! What is your life? You are a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes.
You have kept my eyes from closing; I am too troubled to speak.
I pour out my complaint before Him; I reveal my trouble to Him.
Although my spirit grows faint within me, You know my way. Along the path I travel they have hidden a snare for me.
But when the time had fully come, God sent His Son, born of a woman, born under the law,
“Speak tenderly to Jerusalem, and proclaim to her that her forced labor has been completed; her iniquity has been pardoned. For she has received from the hand of the LORD double for all her sins.”
Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD rises upon you.
Rise up; be our help! Redeem us on account of Your loving devotion.
“Shout for joy and be glad, O Daughter of Zion, for I am coming to dwell among you,” declares the LORD.
And the LORD will take possession of Judah as His portion in the Holy Land, and He will once again choose Jerusalem.

then may You hear from heaven, Your dwelling place, and do according to all for which the foreigner calls to You. Then all the peoples of the earth will know Your name and fear You, as do Your people Israel, and they will know that this house I have built is called by Your Name.

let Your eyes be open and Your ears attentive to hear the prayer that I, Your servant, now pray before You day and night for Your servants, the Israelites. I confess the sins that we Israelites have committed against You. Both I and my fatherʼs house have sinned.
Posterity will serve Him; they will declare the Lord to a new generation.
They will come and proclaim His righteousness to a people yet unborn— all that He has done.
May the groans of the captives reach You; by the strength of Your arm preserve those condemned to death.
For everything that was written in the past was written for our instruction, so that through endurance and the encouragement of the Scriptures, we might have hope.
He executes justice for the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The LORD sets the prisoners free,
Look down from Your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless Your people Israel and the land You have given us as You swore to our fathers—a land flowing with milk and honey.”
The LORD said, “I have indeed seen the affliction of My people in Egypt. I have heard them crying out because of their oppressors, and I am aware of their sufferings.
The people I formed for Myself will declare My praise.
In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look at the earth below; for the heavens will vanish like smoke, the earth will wear out like a garment, and its people will die like gnats. But My salvation will last forever, and My righteousness will never fail.
For in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth and the sea and all that is in them, but on the seventh day He rested. Therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day and set it apart as holy.
Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
“Oh, Lord GOD! You have made the heavens and the earth by Your great power and outstretched arm. Nothing is too difficult for You!
And: “In the beginning, O Lord, You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
You will roll them up like a robe; like a garment they will be changed; but You remain the same, and Your years will never end.”
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.

notes.title: In the beginning you laid the foundations of the earth
